name: Aspashia
source:
"That wish of yours, I'll grant it."
The princess of the kingdom of 'gods' EVUU.
A selfish princess who isn't ladylike or elegant at all, but that's her charm point.
She's a super straightforward person who will honestly say anything that comes to mind with no hesitation.

She's a god-like genie but because her mother was a human she has less magic power and uses it all up because she didn't know that she was actually only half genie.
In order to become a true genie she is thrown down into the human world country 'Kingdom' to grant peoples wishes and gather magic power. 

Her full name is Aspashia Imfraya Pikkina Gindira Azdaramongs
